text: The present continuous: am, is or are, plus ing. It has five uses. Give me five! One: right now. Look! Snow is falling. Two: temporary situations. I am learning to swim at present. Three: changing trends. House husbands are becoming more popular. Four: photos. Everyone is smiling happily in the photo. Five: annoying habits, with always. He is always complaining about his job!

text: The past continuous: was or were, plus ing. Use it for an action in progress at a past time. We were having a barbecue at four o'clock yesterday. For a long action interrupted by a short one. She was waiting for the bus when it suddenly rained. And for two actions at the same time. Fred was watching TV while his mum was preparing dinner.
